decisions.reason: As the firm's award-winning flagship stollen, it remains a key seasonal prestige and sales product with very little reason to withdraw it.
This seed rye mixed bread fits everyday demand for hearty and health-oriented breads and sits comfortably within the bakery's core range.
The dark barley malt rye bread is still somewhat niche, but after earlier portfolio pruning it remains a distinctive artisanal rye option worth retaining.
Marzipan Christmas stollen complements the flagship raisin stollen and supports the firm's important holiday and gift assortment despite being a secondary variant.
The ancient grain bread matches the firm's craft-based, traditional and natural positioning well and offers a differentiated premium bread within the range.
